This package contains the definitions of spectral bands, spectral indices
and constants from the Awesome Spectral Indices project (Montero 2023).

The JSON definition files have been downloaded from 
https://github.com/awesome-spectral-indices/spyndex/tree/main/spyndex/data

See:
https://awesome-spectral-indices.github.io/awesome-spectral-indices/v1.html
https://github.com/awesome-spectral-indices/spyndex

Q: Why don't we just install & import the spyindex package? 
A: spyindex has a lot of requirements and dependencies that QPS does not need.
